verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a password manager with desktop, browser, and CLI clients, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking setting, an opt-out flag, or an environment variable. End-to-end encryption of vault data is an adjacent privacy property, not a telemetry control, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
